LinkedIn Job Scams Used by Chinese Spies for US Intel

Chinese intelligence operatives are reportedly using fake job offers on LinkedIn to target former US government officials and other professionals for information. The scams involve creating fictitious companies to lure individuals who may possess valuable knowledge, including journalists and trade consultants. The operation aims to gather intelligence from individuals potentially connected to US government affairs.
